newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S 28-DAY TIIE RATE FALLS TO 20.68 PCT.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S 28-DAY TIIE RATE FALLS TO 20.68 PCT.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Tuesday, August 12, was fixed at 20.6800 percent, down 14.50 basis points from the August 11 rate of 20.8250 percent, Banco de Mexico said Monday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Tuesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
